rule: a Document is flagged if any Measurement >= its Metric's threshold

arith.balance_break.note: Every untouched Document in train and validation measures exactly 0, so the threshold is the smallest value that means anything.

arith.rate_mismatch.note: Every untouched Document in train and validation measures exactly 0, so the threshold is the smallest value that means anything.

format.date_anomaly.note: No false flag on train and validation at this threshold: halfway between the highest untouched value and the lowest value on a Tamper above it.

format.style_break.note: Never fired on a Tamper in train or validation without also firing elsewhere; set above every untouched value, so it stays quiet.
